comment: The character format used when coupon codes are auto-generated.
modal: Selects the format of automatically generated coupon codes, such as alphanumeric, alphabetical, or numeric character sets.

comment: Text added to the start of every auto-generated coupon code.
modal: An optional prefix prepended to each automatically generated coupon code, useful for grouping or branding codes.

comment: Text added to the end of every auto-generated coupon code.
modal: An optional suffix appended to each automatically generated coupon code.

comment: Enables the RSS feed of coupons and discounts.
modal: When enabled, a public RSS feed of current coupons and discounts is published. (RSS feeds must also be enabled globally.) Can differ per website or store view.
